question: The sum of two numbers is 60 and their HCF and LCM are 12 and 72 respectively. Then find the sum of the reciprocals of the two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product = HCF × LCM = 12 × 72 = 864

Sum = 60

1/a + 1/b = (a + b)/ab = 60/864

= 5/72

**∴ Answer = 5/72**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 60

HCF = 12, LCM = 72

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

1/a + 1/b = (a + b)/ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let numbers be a and b

⇒ ab = 12 × 72 = 864

⇒ a + b = 60

⇒ Required = 1/a + 1/b

⇒ = (a + b)/ab

⇒ = 60/864

⇒ = 5/72

**∴ The correct answer is 5/72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF & LCM Relation

Product = HCF × LCM

Reciprocal Sum

1/a + 1/b = (a + b)/ab

Simplification

Reduce fraction to lowest terms
